title: Affordance-Guided Coarse-to-Fine Exploration for Mobile Manipulation
summary: 提供 contact point -> stand region 的直接几何构造，不要求一开始训练完整 floor-affordance network。

mechanisms.name: Affordance-Guided Coarse-to-Fine Exploration for Mobile Manipulation
mechanisms.description: GroundedSAM 与 VLM 找 affordance keypoint，投到 obstacle map；以截断 Gaussian 生成候选站位，从语义粗定位切到局部几何。
mechanisms.limitations: VLM keypoint 会 hallucinate；机器人地图/动作设置；总成功率无法归因到 affordance。
